# @nan0web/payload-cms Monorepo

> Monorepo ecosystem for Payload CMS 3.x plugins and applications (@nan0web/payload-*). Built with pure ESM, Model-as-Schema architecture, native Node.js APIs, DevSecOps principles, and OLMUI (One Logic — Multiple User Interfaces).
> **Critical Architectural Isolation:** This repository is an autonomous ecosystem (`apps/3rdparty/payload-cms`). Packages here MUST NOT use `workspace:*` links to the outer NaN0Web monorepo. Any platform dependencies (such as `@nan0web/types`, `@nan0web/i18n`) must be consumed strictly as published NPM packages (`^x.y.z`).
